receipts.result: The pinned Python 3.14.7 test lane passes 123 focused tests, including 68 new tests (47 reader, 14 CLI, 7 protocol-boundary controls). The expanded regression passes 231 of 233 tests; two unchanged job-00 regeneration checks select x18=-1.9634954084936207 against the retained 1.1780972450961724, a pi gauge difference, and are not reported as passes. Pinned Ruff checks and formatting pass across 975 files; mypy passes all five changed Python files. The whole-repository type process exits 247 without a diagnostic and is not qualified by the focused pass. The global plan and Markdown checks pass for 144 plans and 793 materialized Markdown files. Historical protocol/contract producers and retained records remain byte-identical; no QPU job or physical claim is admitted. An isolated producer-only reproduction loads no new network module and matches all 20 loaded repository modules to the input revision; retained and regenerated requests both pass complete-operator validation. The native-numeric-replay workstream owns cross-identity comparison; these observations do not establish identical physical compilation.

First-pass review fixes: 162 focused tests pass (137 reader, 18 command-line, 7 protocol-boundary controls; 68 before) and exercise each rejection, review-readiness, scoring and integrity-issue branch of the reader and the bounded read, atomic replacement and parsed-snapshot hash of the command line. The declared-block lookup and the per-block grouping of analyze_joint are linear; the report of a 1600-block, 28,800-cell record is unchanged and its analysis falls from 4.24 s to 2.32 s. The runbook states that the provider comment body is not retained and that the assessment's statements are paraphrases. The observation is of the uncommitted tree on top of the revision named here; hosted revalidation of the resulting head is not observed.

Review-finding fixes: the joint record requires an endpoint_roles map (bell_station and receiver) that must assign each apparatus once and follow the protocol direction; processing_status and processing_chain must agree (raw_detector_counts with an empty chain, processed_counts with a nonempty one); a case whose source_repository differs from the canonical repository is listed under unsupported_scope; the JSON depth limit counts the root object as level 1 and is tested at 63, 64 and 65. The five-file focused selection collects 237 tests (157 reader, 18 command-line, 7 protocol-boundary controls, 28 protocol model, 27 classical benchmark) and all pass. Three 64 MiB digests run serially in 0.10-0.18 s against 0.25-0.42 s through parallel.ordered_map, which pickles each buffer, so the digests stay serial. The provider comment digest, URL and paraphrases are documented as externally unverifiable from the tree. The observation is of the uncommitted tree on top of the revision named here; hosted revalidation of the resulting head is not observed.
